name: Conga Contracts
description_en:
Conga’s legal service description separately names Conga Contracts and lists contract creation, approvals, tracked changes and reporting. It should not inherit every capability of Conga CLM, Contracts for Salesforce or the broader platform. The original catalog website points to a general CLM path, so use the named service scope when discussing this record.

The named feature list includes requesting a contract, approving requests, acting on flows, sending for negotiation and displaying status. A proposed pilot should follow one supplier request through these stages, checking document versions and permissions after an exception. Record who owns each handoff and compare the resulting repository entry with the approved document. This example was not executed.
description_zh:
Conga 法律服务说明单独列出 Conga Contracts，描述合同创建、批准、变更追踪与报表。不能把 Conga CLM、Contracts for Salesforce 或整个平台的所有能力移入本记录。原目录网址指向通用 CLM 路径，因此本档案以明确命名的单品服务范围为依据。

单品功能清单包括申请合同、批准申请、处理流程、送交谈判与显示状态。建议试点让一份供应商申请经过这些阶段，并在例外后核对版本与权限。应记录交接负责人，把最终档案与批准文件进行对照。本示例未执行。

items.en: The service description qualifies features by individual configuration. It supports evaluating a contract repository and workflow, not assuming source access or customer-operated deployment. Exact signing failure, retry, rollback and export behavior were not verified. Teams needing broad CRM-native contracting should first resolve the product-edition boundary. Preserve reviewed versions and inspect current status before repeating a failed action; this is evaluation guidance.
items.zh: 服务说明限定功能取决于具体配置。可据此评估合同档案与流程，但不能假定取得源码或客户自营部署。精确的签署失败、重试、回滚和导出行为未核实。需要广泛 CRM 原生合同管理的团队应先明确产品版本边界。重复失败动作前应保留审查版本并检查当前状态；这是评估建议。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No reliable payable amount, trial entitlement or sustained free tier was read. The general product page returned a security check, and the documentation portal returned an unsupported-browser page. Keep pricing unverified rather than importing a CLM-family quote. Confirm exact product, user roles, signing/integration requirements, implementation and recurring fees with the provider.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 未读到可靠的应付金额、试用权益或长期免费层。通用产品页返回安全检查，文档门户返回不支持浏览器页面。因此保留价格未核实，不能套用 CLM 家族报价。需向厂商确认具体单品、用户角色、签署／集成要求、实施及经常性费用。
